footnote_text: Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of August 2, 2026, by and among the issuer, Armstrong Parent, Inc., and Armstrong Bidco, Inc. (the "Merger Agreement"), (i) each share of common stock of the issuer, par value $0.001 per share ("Issuer Common Stock"), held by the reporting person was converted into the right to receive $127 in cash, without interest (the "Merger Consideration"), (ii) each vested restricted stock unit ("RSU") award held by the reporting person was canceled and converted into the right to receive a cash amount equal to (x) the number of shares of Issuer Common Stock subject to such RSU award, multiplied by (y) the Merger Consideration,... || (continuation of footnote 1 above). (iii) each unvested RSU award held by the reporting person was canceled and converted into a cash amount equal to (x) the number of shares of Issuer Common Stock subject to such RSU award, multiplied by (y) the Merger Consideration, 50% of which is payable as soon as practicable (assessed on a tranche-by-tranche basis) and the remaining 50% of which will be paid subject to satisfaction of the same vesting conditions that applied to the corresponding RSU award, and... || (continuation of footnote 2 above). (iv) each performance stock unit ("PSU") award held by the reporting person was canceled and converted into a cash amount equal to (x) the number of shares of Issuer Common Stock subject to such PSU award based on the greater of target performance and actual performance, multiplied by (y) the Merger Consideration, 50% of which is payable as soon as practicable (assessed on a tranche-by-tranche basis) and the remaining 50% of which will be paid subject to satisfaction of the same service vesting conditions (without regard to any performance conditions) that applied to the corresponding PSU award.

Disposed of pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of August 2, 2026, by and among the issuer, Armstrong Parent, Inc., and Armstrong Bidco, Inc. (the "Merger Agreement"). || Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, (i) each share of common stock of the issuer, par value $0.001 per share, held by the reporting person was converted into the right to receive $127 in cash, without interest (the "Merger Consideration"), and (ii) as a result of the reporting person's departure from the board of directors of the issuer at the effective time of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement, each restricted stock unit held by the reporting person was canceled and converted into the right to receive a cash amount equal to the Merger Consideration.
